headline: CSL Finance Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations - CSL Capital Private Ltd has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosures under Regulation 10(6)-Report to stock Exchange in respect of any acquisition made in reliance upon exemption provided…
detail: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations - CSL Capital Private Ltd has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosures under Regulation 10(6)-Report to stock Exchange in respect of any acquisition made in reliance upon exemption provided for in regulation 10 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.
